sonido/9233d2c:
F1: save debounce 150→300 ticks, comment corrected to ~100 Hz poll rate.
F2: build_graph returns Result — runtime compile failures log error and
    keep previous graph instead of panicking.
F3: MIDI clock ÷24 divider so TapTempo gets 1 tap/beat. Added is_start/
    is_stop to MidiEvent; Start resets divider, Stop halts tapping.
F4: boot counter persisted in TAMP backup register (survives IWDG reset).
    3+ rapid reboots → force bypass. boot_success_guard clears after 5s.
F5: write_knob always updates knobs_prev — prevents sub-epsilon ADC drift
    from accumulating into spurious change events.
F6+F7: in-place graph rebuild via clear_topology() + rebuild_graph().
    Preserves crossfade buffers for click-free effect switching. Added
    input_id()/output_id() public accessors to ProcessingGraph.
sonido/92d65c4:
ADAA epsilon 1e-7→1e-5 (fixes soft-clip stereo artifacts from catastrophic
cancellation in finite-difference quotient). Compressor gains parallel mix
param [10] (ParamId 310, 0-100%, default 100%) for NY-style compression.
Tape saturation default 50→30%, multivibrato depths ~2x with 400% max scale,
flanger default depth 50→35%.

bridged_knob now respects ParamScale — log-scaled params (filter cutoff,
LFO rates, EQ bands) map through normalize/denormalize so 12 o'clock sits
at geometric mean (~632 Hz for 20-20k) instead of linear midpoint (~10.5k).
Prerequisite for plugin hosts which communicate in normalized [0,1] space.

GUI starts with empty chain and file-input mode (loop on). Users build
their own signal path via the "+" button.

clob/92b1af6:
Fix the design and verdict rules for the first real Bet 1 measurement
before the run exists: two arms (latent, forward-through-ternary QAT)
each trained under both established recipes on the pinned Moby-Dick
corpus, small config, seed 1, window 32, 20000 steps, checkpoints every
2500. Each run's checkpoint is selected by a 4000-token holdout curve
in the arm's deployed view and judged on the full holdout; each arm's
representative is its better recipe. The capability verdict is the
registered Bet 1 line on the QAT-ternary versus f32-latent gap (pass at
1.25x, kill above 1.5x), behind a validity precondition that the f32
control beats the holdout unigram baseline.

The memory line is fixed to Bet 1's sub-2-bit-per-weight recurrent core
wording before any result exists: judged on the ternary-eligible core
matrix families under the deployed TernaryMatrix encoding (12.66x
smaller by construction at small/3260), with the 1.34x whole-model
ratio reported as context so the un-ternarized vocab tables stay
visible. latent_A replicates the Bet 7 training run, doubling as an
internal consistency check. run.sh is the registered procedure.
